reasons.1: Hero has no Buy action; the only primary action on the first screen is the small header pill, and the hero offers just a 'See the specs' text link.
reasons.2: Specs and Buy sections leave a tall empty left column under short headings; section padding is large and uneven against content height.
reasons.3: 3D viewer sits inside a framed card, and Buy section is one short line of content inside a large band; little real information per screen.
reasons.4: Uppercase eyebrow 'WIRELESS SPEAKER' above the h1, and the checker flags one gradient background (vignette behind the model).
reasons.7: Checker reports 2 controls under 44x44 px on phone; otherwise 390 px layout stacks cleanly with no sideways scroll.
reasons.9: 02-technical-architecture.md lists the stack (Vite, three.js) with only decision IDs, not reasons; otherwise PRD, DESIGN.md tokens, frontend spec and tickets are consistent.
reasons.10: Tickets have checks but no explicit file list or stop point, and T6 to T10 are one-line notes rather than pasteable prompts.

A.top_fix: Add a primary Buy button in the hero next to 'See the specs' so the main action is visible without the header, and drop the eyebrow label.

reasons.1: Giant dashed '[Speaker name]' placeholder dominates the hero, and a stray 'Try again' link under the viewer competes with the Buy button.
reasons.2: Front/Side/Back/Top group and 'Reset view' run past the container to the window's right edge and are cut off at the bottom of the desktop first screen.
reasons.3: Yellow dashed underlines on nearly every value (header, h1, price, every spec row, buy band, footer) make the page visually noisy.
reasons.6: 'Try again' (the failed-state retry) is visible while the model has rendered normally, so the shown state contradicts the spec's state table.
reasons.7: Checker reports 1 control under 44x44 px on phone (the 'Reset view' text link sits alone on its own row); no sideways scroll at 390 px.

B.top_fix: Hide 'Try again' unless the viewer is in the failed state, and pull the view buttons and Reset view back inside the 1200 px container.

why: B gives Cursor a more complete, pasteable build pack (stack with reasons, tokens.css, tickets with goal, files, checks and a stop point) and puts Buy in the hero, while A's page is calmer but its hero lacks a primary action and its tickets lack stop points.
